title: Refill Timing and Processing Times by Program — Home Delivery Pharmacy Service Levels
content:
## Service-level table

Refill timing and processing times at the Home Delivery Pharmacy differ by program as follows.

| | Voluntary | Standard | Maintenance 90 | Advantage | Maintenance Choice | Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Automatic refills available | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Days of supply remaining when an automatic refill is processed | 14 | 14 | 14 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Drugs never eligible for automatic refills | oxycodone-acetaminophen | oxycodone-acetaminophen | oxycodone-acetaminophen | oxycodone-acetaminophen | oxycodone-acetaminophen | oxycodone-acetaminophen |
| Share of the previous home delivery fill's days supply that must have elapsed before a refill is dispensed | 0.75 | 0.7 | 0.67 | 0.67 | 0.67 | 0.67 |
| New-prescription processing (business days to process and dispense after receipt) | 5 | 5 | 4 | 4 | 3 | 2 |
| Refill processing (business days to process and dispense a refill order) | 3 | 3 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 1 |

### Notes

- The new-prescription and refill figures are the program's new-prescription processing business days and refill processing business days.
- The elapsed share is read against the days supply of the previous shipped fill: 0.75 means 75 percent of that supply, 0.7 means 70 percent and 0.67 means 67 percent.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical fill)

A previous home delivery fill carried a 90-day supply. Under Northbridge Home Delivery Voluntary 0.75 of 90 days, 67.5 days, must have elapsed before the refill ships; under Northbridge Home Delivery Standard 0.7 of 90 days, 63 days; under any of the other four programs 0.67 of 90 days, 60.3 days.
